over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — Nexeo Solutions realized record (bounded window, ~2019–2021)

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. This sub-dossier describes ONLY the realized
> post-closing-era trajectory. It contains no information about how the transaction or
> organization was structured at the closing era.

## Outcome window
- The fixed outcome window is the registrant's own realized record 3–5 years after the ~2016 closing era (approximately 2019–2021). The public reporting entity in that period is Nexeo Solutions, Inc. (SEC CIK 1604416, formerly WL Ross Holding Corp.), through which the business became publicly reporting after mid-2016. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-18-014867, 10-K FY2018 (fiscal year ended September 30, 2018)]
- The standalone public record terminates at the start of the window: the entity was acquired and deregistered in early 2019, so no separate 3–5-year (2019–2021) public record exists for the business as an independent registrant. The outcome is therefore bounded/uncertain (see the terminal-event section below). [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-19-071988, Form 15-12B filed March 12, 2019]

## Last realized standalone annual record (fiscal year ended September 30, 2018)
- Sales and operating revenues were $4,034.2 million for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2018, up $397.3 million (10.9%) from $3,636.9 million for fiscal 2017; by line of business, Chemicals were $1,904.5 million and Plastics were $1,980.0 million. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-18-014867, 10-K FY2018]
- Net income was $29.4 million for fiscal 2018, compared with $14.4 million for fiscal 2017 (a 104.2% increase); gross profit was $460.1 million (versus $398.4 million in fiscal 2017). [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-18-014867, 10-K FY2018]
- Net cash provided by operating activities was $88.7 million for fiscal 2018. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-18-014867, 10-K FY2018]
- At September 30, 2018 the company had approximately 2,760 employees worldwide (approximately 2,190 in the U.S.). [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-18-014867, 10-K FY2018]

## Realized platform activity over the period
- The distribution platform continued to add businesses during the public period: the Ultra Chem Acquisition closed April 3, 2017 (the equity interests of the Mexico City, Mexico–based chemicals distribution business of the Ultra Chem Group). [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-18-014867, 10-K FY2018]

## Terminal event and end of the standalone public record
- On September 17, 2018, Nexeo entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Univar Inc. (with Merger Sub I and Merger Sub II) providing for the acquisition of Nexeo by Univar. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-18-014867, 10-K FY2018]
- On February 28, 2019, Univar Inc. completed the acquisition via a two-step merger: Merger Sub I merged with and into Nexeo (with Nexeo surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Univar), and immediately thereafter Nexeo merged with and into Merger Sub II, which survived as the surviving company and a wholly owned subsidiary of Univar. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-19-059190, 8-K dated March 1, 2019]
- In connection with the closing, Nexeo Solutions, LLC repaid all amounts outstanding under its $575 million multicurrency ABL credit facility (dated June 9, 2016) effective February 28, 2019. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-19-059190, 8-K Item 1.02]
- The Nexeo common shares, warrants and units (Nasdaq symbol "NXEOU") ceased trading and were delisted from Nasdaq as of the market open on March 1, 2019; Forms 25 to delist and deregister the securities under Section 12(b) were filed. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-19-059190, 8-K; SEC accession 0001354457-19-000102, Form 25-NSE filed March 1, 2019]
- The entity filed a Form 15-12B to deregister/suspend its reporting obligations on March 12, 2019, ending its separate public reporting. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-19-071988, Form 15-12B]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Through its last standalone annual record (fiscal year ended September 30, 2018), the business grew revenue to $4,034.2 million and net income to $29.4 million (from $14.4 million in fiscal 2017), continuing to add distribution businesses (e.g., Ultra Chem, April 2017). [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-18-014867, 10-K FY2018]
- The standalone public trajectory then ended: Univar Inc. completed its acquisition of the entity on February 28, 2019, the securities were delisted from Nasdaq on March 1, 2019, and a Form 15-12B deregistration was filed March 12, 2019. Because the business was absorbed into Univar and deregistered at the start of the outcome window, no separate 3–5-year (2019–2021) public record exists for it as an independent registrant, and the outcome is coded uncertain/bounded (a consolidated segment trajectory would be Univar's, not separately disclosed for the acquired business here). [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-19-059190, 8-K; SEC accession 0001193125-19-071988, Form 15-12B]

[SLICE END]
